name: aponiajs-workspace
description: Bun-first application architecture powered by Elysia.

scripts.version:bump: bumpp package.json packages/aponiajs/package.json packages/audit/package.json packages/auth/package.json packages/cache/package.json packages/cli/package.json packages/common/package.json packages/compression/package.json packages/core/package.json packages/cors/package.json packages/create-aponia/package.json packages/cron/package.json packages/database/package.json packages/devtools/package.json packages/events/package.json packages/graphql/package.json packages/http/package.json packages/idempotency/package.json packages/mcp/package.json packages/metrics/package.json packages/microservices/package.json packages/h3/package.json packages/hono/package.json packages/nitro/package.json packages/serverless/package.json packages/openapi/package.json packages/opentelemetry/package.json packages/platform-elysia/package.json packages/queue/package.json packages/rate-limit/package.json packages/security/package.json packages/session/package.json packages/tenancy/package.json packages/testing/package.json --all --no-commit --no-tag --no-push --execute "bun run version:sync"
scripts.version:sync: bun scripts/sync-version-references.ts && bun install --lockfile-only && bun run release:verify
scripts.release:dry-run: for package in audit auth cache compression events http idempotency common core platform-elysia queue cli create-aponia devtools cron database cors graphql mcp metrics microservices serverless h3 hono nitro testing openapi opentelemetry rate-limit security session tenancy; do bun pm pack --cwd packages/$package --dry-run; done
